source.title: Yale Bright Star Catalog, 5th revised ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991)

bvNote: stars without a catalog B-V get one inverted from the catalog colour temperature K (Ballesteros' formula); 0.6 if neither exists

galacticRotation.usage: e = (cos(dec)cos(ra), cos(dec)sin(ra), sin(dec)); g = M * e; l = atan2(g.y, g.x); b = asin(g.z)

validation.note: longitude error is scaled by cos(b); catalog GLON/GLAT are given to 0.01 deg

caveats: HR 5958 (T CrB, recurrent nova) is listed at its outburst magnitude V=2.0; it is ~V 10 in quiescence.
